chains.title: The government's side of the crisis
steps: Late 1980s: government spending far exceeds revenue
The gap (the deficit) is covered by borrowing
Borrowing on this scale becomes unsustainable

chains.title: The external side: the balance of payments crisis
steps: Borrowed foreign exchange spent on consumption; exports neglected
Imports grow fast without matching exports
Forex reserves can't pay for even two weeks of imports
Too little forex even to pay interest to foreign lenders
India can't repay its foreign borrowings: a balance of payments crisis

chains.title: The rescue and the New Economic Policy
steps: No country or international funder will lend to India
World Bank (IBRD) and IMF lend $7 billion
Conditions: free the private sector, shrink government's role, remove trade barriers
India announces the New Economic Policy (NEP)
Reforms under three heads: liberalisation, privatisation, globalisation

chains.title: Devaluation of the rupee, 1991
steps: 1991: rupee devalued as an immediate step against the crisis
Immediate effect: the inflow of foreign exchange increases
Longer term: it sets the tone to free the rupee from government control
Now, more often than not, markets set exchange rates

chains.title: Mahadeva and cheap imports
steps: Restrictions on imports removed; import duties cut
Cheap imported edible oils flood local markets
Mahadeva can't sell his groundnut at a price that covers his cost

chains.title: The fertiliser subsidy cut
steps: Fertiliser subsidy partly removed
Cost of production rises
Small and marginal farmers severely affected

chains.title: Box 3.3: the Siricilla tragedy
steps: Power reforms end subsidised electricity; power tariffs rise steeply
Workers in small industries such as powerloom weaving are hit
Wages tied to cloth output, so power cuts also cut wages
A crisis in the weavers' livelihood
50 powerloom workers die by suicide in Siricilla

chains.title: Why industrial growth slowed (with weak infrastructure too)
steps: The economy opens to a greater flow of goods from abroad
Cheaper imports replace demand for domestic goods
Domestic manufacturers face competition from imports
Industrial growth slows down

chains.title: Why income tax rates were cut after 1991
steps: High income tax rates seen as a main reason for tax evasion
Taxes on individual incomes cut continuously since 1991
Moderate rates encourage savings and voluntary disclosure of income
